name: Rosa & Juliet
source:
Sohenwicht University lies ahead, where time and space inside have begun to fray. We've been here before, and it didn't end well. 

This time, we have to proceed with caution.

[From [url=https://chazakiel.itch.io/rosajuliet]Itch.io[/url]]
